# README Requirements-Quality Checklist: InOutManager

**Purpose**: Evaluar completitud, claridad y consistencia de los requisitos e instrucciones documentados en el README del proyecto.
**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [README.md](../../../README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are supported Node.js, npm, and MongoDB versions or minimum prerequisites specified? [Completeness, README §Tecnologías Utilizadas]
- [ ] CHK002 Are installation, configuration, and startup prerequisites documented before the `start:both` instruction? [Gap, README §Herramientas de Desarrollo]
- [ ] CHK003 Are required environment variables and secret configuration requirements documented without exposing secret values? [Gap, README §Herramientas de Desarrollo]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the expected local frontend/backend addresses, ports, and database connection settings specified? [Gap, README §Herramientas de Desarrollo]
- [ ] CHK005 Are expected setup and startup failure cases, such as unavailable MongoDB or occupied ports, covered by clear guidance? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements for employee data, audit information, and backup/restore scope documented, including any retention or recovery expectations? [Completeness, README §Gestión de Usuarios; README §Panel de Administración Avanzado]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is it clear whether each capability under “Características Implementadas” is released, partially available, or planned? [Clarity, README §Características Implementadas]
- [ ] CHK008 Are broad claims such as “completo”, “avanzados”, “preciso” and “en tiempo real” defined by concrete scope or measurable criteria? [Ambiguity, README §Descripción del Proyecto; README §Estadísticas y Reportes]
- [ ] CHK009 Does the startup guidance distinguish MongoDB Compass (a client) from the MongoDB server, and clarify the meaning of `localhost:27017/inoutmanager`? [Ambiguity, README §Herramientas de Desarrollo]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the legal date range, applicable employee population, and assumptions behind “legislación laboral 2025” stated clearly enough to bound the claim? [Clarity, README §Descripción del Proyecto; README §Registro de Asistencia y Control de Jornada]
- [ ] CHK011 Are expected user roles and the meaning of the administrative code, recovery codes, and session/logout behavior explained without relying on undefined terms? [Clarity, README §Autenticación y Autorización]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are role names and permissions consistent across authentication, user management, attendance, reports, and administration sections? [Consistency, README §Autenticación y Autorización; README §Gestión de Usuarios]
- [ ] CHK013 Do the project description, technology list, and feature claims describe the same supported scope without implying conflicting capabilities? [Consistency, README §Descripción del Proyecto; README §Tecnologías Utilizadas; README §Características Implementadas]
- [ ] CHK014 Are security claims consistent with the documented expectations for authentication, password protection, secrets, input handling, and administrative access? [Consistency, README §Autenticación y Autorización; README §Gestión de Usuarios; Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality and Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Can claims such as “validación completa”, “cálculo automático”, “reportes personalizados” and “actualización automática” be evaluated against stated outcomes or thresholds? [Measurability, README §Autenticación y Autorización; README §Registro de Asistencia y Control de Jornada; README §Estadísticas y Reportes]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the expected employee and administrator outcomes for the main attendance, history, reporting, and correction scenarios described, including relevant exceptions? [Coverage, README §Registro de Asistencia y Control de Jornada; README §Panel de Administración Avanzado]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add review findings inline and link to relevant documentation.
